entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Sunil Kumar Kushwaha
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Umesh Chandra Prajapati
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.

Heard Sri Virendra Singh Patel, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Umesh Chandra Prajapati,
learned counsel for opposite party no.2 and Sri Raj Bahadur Verma, learned AGA for the State.

2. The present application has been filed to quash the summoning order dated 14.06.2021 as well as charge sheet dated 18.11.2020 passed in Criminal Case No.3956 of 2021, under Sections-498A, 323,
504, 506 IPC & Section-3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, arising out of Case Crime No.432 of 2020,
Police Station-Kotwali, District-Jhansi, pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jhansi.
3.

Learned counsel for the applicants submits that dispute between the parties is matrimonial in nature and now they have settled their dispute amicably and a compromise has also been entered into between them.

4. Per contra, learned AGA has raised a preliminary objection that compromise is yet to be verified Ravi @ Ravi Prakash Kushwaha vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171326415/
1 by the court below, therefore, applicants may be directed to file compromise before the court below for verification.

entities.text: Ravi @ Ravi Prakash Kushwaha vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Considering the aforesaid submission, present application is disposed of with a direction to the applicants to file original deed of compromise before the court below, within a period of 15 days.

In case, such compromise is filed before the court below, the court below will verify the same after summoning the parties within a period of two months from the date of receiving the copy of compromise.
6. After verification of the compromise, court below will dispose of the impugned proceeding, in accordance with law.
7. It is further provided that for a period of two and a half months or till the verification of compromise, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants.
8. It is further provided that applicants are at liberty to file fresh application u/s 528 of BNSS, to quash the impugned proceeding on the basis of verified compromise.

Order Date :- 7.4.2025 S.Chaurasia  Ravi @ Ravi Prakash Kushwaha vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171326415/
